regions.full_page: God bless you these days, you and yours. I hope you keep well. I hope too that Mr. Rand recover soon, as also your Niece -- . We will pray for them. Why not suggest to each of them -- for that matter to any one in trouble -- that they make a proposition to do something specially pleasing to God if things go more favorable, if an operation be averted or a favorable surprise of telling importance come their way? I think I can honestly say that is one of the principal secrets of the many many favors reported at our monasteries as through the Ser. Mass Association. Stress especially offering holy Communions and praying for the poor missions. Nothing like frequent Holy Communion and holy Masses for the intentions of the intentions of our dear dear Lord; and surely one of His outstanding intentions is that one for which He pleads: " .... The laborers " ... The harvest indeed is great but the laborers are few. Pray ye therefore, that the Lord of the harvest send laborers ". God bless you again. Sincerely Yours in Christ and His mission works.
